title: Agreement under short-query oracle agreement
statement: Let $N$ be an oracle nondeterministic Turing machine, let $O$ and $O'$ be oracle languages, and let $x$ be an input word and $w$ a finite sequence of choice bits. Suppose that for every word $z$ with $|z|<|w|$, membership in $O$ agrees with membership in $O'$. Then running $N$ with either oracle on $w$ from its initial configuration on $x$ yields the same final configuration.
hypotheses_covered: for every word z of length less than |w|, z belongs to O if and only if z belongs to O'
